summary: Implemented all six phases: a shared source-store path classification library (scripts/lib/source-store-path-lib.sh), an out-of-repository pre-check and repository-naming notice at the phase-commit site under a new 'source store excursion' issue class, a single-pathspec fail-open-unconditional second-repository commit mechanism (scripts/commit-source-store-path.sh), a shape-based unexpanded-shell-variable refusal at the harvest and plan-validation authoring boundaries, matching documentation in git-staging-scope.md/plan-format.md/planner-agent.md, and manifest derivation plus a deploy. All four acceptance criteria are satisfied with test evidence (309 directly-run assertions across 5 suites, all passing). A bug in the classification library's SOURCE_STORE attribution (wrong relative-path base) was found and fixed during Phase 4's own end-to-end verification. The complete gate set's residual findings are attributed to a concurrently-dispatched sibling task's own in-flight edits/commits and to pre-existing, out-of-scope conditions, both recorded in the issue log.
